text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: LT23-L01 / Contact forces and attachment review

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Free-spring extrapolation replaced by compression-only coils, a candidate bumper law and unilateral restraints

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b95035

g.text: LT23 · 21 OCT 2026 · STRUCTURAL REVIEW CANDIDATE · NOT FOR FABRICATION

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Maximum link demand 22.73 kN; retained section probe 80 kN. Rebound probe 40.91 kN.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Ø50 traction pins, 20 mm cheeks, four 12 mm stiffeners and 8 mm nominal bracket welds remain review candidates.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: The cylinder crossbeam, extensions and decorative shells move down 25 mm to clear the sampled front pitch demand.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Retained 6 mm stop-base weld and guide attachments receive updated demands. No stress/fatigue adequacy is asserted.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203e49

g.text: Hard/rebound/roll contacts are rigid constraints; reactions are quasi-static. Actual bumper curves, impacts and damping are still missing.
